remarks: Welcome to Norwalk.... This charming newly renovated home, located in the Springhill section of Norwalk. Nestled in a fully fenced in enchanted yard. Walking distance to Norwalk hospital.  This 4- bedroom 2 bathroom features, open concept living room with fireplace. All new kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartz counters. Newly renovated bathrooms, nice sized basement with laundry and ample storage. This home also has a deck for outside events, fully fenced in front and backyard with privacy. Security cameras, Central air conditioning. Close to I-95, Shopping and so much more. Don't miss the chance to make this stunning property home!
